ei.title: Why Fashion Needs to Be More Sustainable
ei.subject: 공통영어1

fullPassage:
Why Fashion Needs to Be More Sustainable

Jessi is a fashion blogger who loves unique, vibrant clothes. But guess what? She does not buy new clothes. Instead, she buys them secondhand. You may think secondhand clothes are old-fashioned, but by buying them, Jessi can try different styles. She also does not get too attached to any style or brand because there is always another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered. Jessi's clothing habits are not just about creating a style; they are about saving the Earth. The reason is that her actions help reduce the production and consumption of clothes.

Worth over $3 trillion and making up 2% of the world's GDP, the fashion industry today has an almost entirely linear approach. The process moves in a straight line from design to consumption to disposal. Material extraction, textile manufacturing, the supply chain, design, sales, marketing, and other steps are guided by the aim of maximizing garment consumption without considering other issues. Due to linear fashion, the fashion industry negatively affects the environment. 85% of textiles go into landfills, only 1% of the materials is recycled, at least 500,000 tons of microfibers end up in the ocean (equal to 50 billion plastic bottles), and 93 billion cubic meters of water is required for textile production annually. Alarming numbers like these will keep increasing if producers maintain the old system. It is clear that waste and pollution from the fashion industry must be reduced. Linear fashion must change, and this could happen through circular fashion.

Circular fashion is inspired by the principles of a circular economy and sustainable development. A circular economy is based on limiting waste, keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing them. In a circular model, we make, use, and reuse materials for as long as possible to extract their maximum value. Therefore, clothing and textiles are produced, used, and reused to minimize waste. It is a renewable approach to reduce the fashion industry's environmental impact. Circular fashion provides numerous benefits. First, extending the lifespan of fibers significantly reduces textile waste, benefiting the environment. Second, circular processes utilize chemicals and materials safe for human health and the environment. This practice protects the environment and consumer health. Third, materials are regenerated instead of being disposed of, which enables their long-term use.

The rise of circular fashion is facilitated by new technology and ideas. Materials commonly used in clothing are not eco-friendly because they require considerable resources and often break down slowly. This creates a need for eco-friendly textile alternatives. Currently, companies are developing recycled fibers and fibers extracted from agricultural waste products like leaves, peels, and seeds. One company uses nanotechnology to make soft material from orange peels. Another makes fabrics from kapok tree seeds. The trees grow well in poor soil without needing much water. These new fabrics produce less waste, last a long time, and break down easily.

In addition to these manufacturing techniques, technology will improve in such a way that it may become normal to produce clothes only when people order them. This "make-to-order" method will cost more, but then less money will be spent on maintaining offline stores. And 3D technology will enable people to see how clothes will fit online without trying them on in a store. In the long run, innovation in production and sales will facilitate sustainable fashion and considerably reduce material waste and logistics emissions.

Another key to making fashion sustainable is the consumer: us. If we want the fashion industry to adopt more sustainable practices, we must care about how clothes come to us. We should then demonstrate our concerns through what we buy. The market, of course, will respond. We can also reduce waste by discarding clothes responsibly. To be specific, we should buy only what we need and pass clothing on to someone who will wear it or to a thrift shop when discarding it.

Circular fashion will not solve every problem in the fashion industry overnight. However, small steps in the right direction are better than nothing. Keeping things in the supply chain for as many cycles as possible is really important. By making small changes to our clothing habits today, the fashion industry will gradually improve. After all, nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① buying(사는 것) → 정상 / ② waited → waiting(기다리는) / ③ creating(만드는) → 정상 / ④ reduce(줄이다) → 정상.
det.analysis:
✅ ① buying: 전치사 by 뒤 동명사 — 정상.
❌ ② waited: 원문은 waiting. outfit이 발견되기를 '기다리는' 능동 의미이므로 현재분사(waiting) 필요. waited(과거분사)는 틀림. ←정답
✅ ③ creating: 전치사 about 뒤 동명사 — 정상.
✅ ④ reduce: help + 동사원형 — 정상.
det.tip: 명사 수식 분사: 능동(~하는) → 현재분사(-ing), 수동(~된) → 과거분사(-ed).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① are guided(이끌리다) → 정상 / ② considered → considering(고려하는) / ③ is(~이다) → 정상 / ④ increasing(증가하는) → 정상.
det.analysis:
✅ ① are guided: steps are guided by — 복수주어 수동태 정상.
❌ ② considered: 원문은 considering. 전치사 without 뒤 동명사(-ing) 필요. considered(과거분사)는 틀림. ←정답
✅ ③ is: 93 billion cubic meters of water is required — 불가산 명사 water 기준 단수 정상.
✅ ④ increasing: keep increasing — keep + 동명사 정상.
det.tip: 전치사(without) 뒤 → 동명사(considering). 과거분사 불가.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① extending(연장하는 것) → 정상 / ② safe(안전한) → 정상 / ③ being disposed(폐기되는 것) → 정상 / ④ that → which(계속적 용법).
det.analysis:
✅ ① extending: 동명사 주어 — 정상.
✅ ② safe: materials safe for — 형용사 후치수식 정상.
✅ ③ being disposed: instead of being disposed of — 전치사 뒤 동명사 수동형 정상.
❌ ④ that: 원문은 which. 콤마(,) 뒤 계속적 용법의 관계대명사는 which만 가능. that은 계속적 용법에 쓸 수 없음. ←정답
det.tip: 계속적 용법(, + 관계대명사): which만 가능. that 불가. 선행사 = 앞 절 전체.

det.korean: 제한하는. 극대화하다. 이로운. 안전한.
det.analysis:
✅ ① limiting: limiting waste — 폐기물 제한. 원문 그대로.
❌ ② maximize: 원문은 minimize. 순환 모델의 목적은 폐기물 '최소화'이므로 maximize(극대화)는 문맥 반대. ←정답
✅ ③ benefiting: benefiting the environment — 원문 그대로.
✅ ④ safe: materials safe for human health — 원문 그대로.
det.tip: minimize(최소화) ↔ maximize(극대화). 순환 패션 목적 = 폐기물 최소화.

det.korean: 유지하는. 촉진하다. 줄이다. 무시하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① maintaining: maintaining offline stores — 원문 그대로.

det.tip: care about(관심을 갖다) ↔ ignore(무시하다). 소비자 역할 = 관심 갖기.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선형 패션의 문제 → 해결책으로 ____을 제시.
det.analysis:
✅ ① circular fashion(순환 패션) ←정답: 원문 그대로. 선형 패션의 대안으로 순환 패션 제시.
❌ ② digital innovation(디지털 혁신): 문맥 무관.
❌ ③ economic reform(경제 개혁): 문맥 무관.
❌ ④ global cooperation(국제 협력): 문맥 무관.
det.tip: linear fashion의 대안 = circular fashion. 직선 → 순환으로 전환.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 옷을 버릴 때 입을 사람이나 ____에 전달해야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a fashion designer(패션 디자이너): 문맥 부적합.
❌ ② a textile factory(직물 공장): 문맥 부적합.
✅ ③ a thrift shop(중고품 가게) ←정답: 원문 그대로. 옷을 버릴 때 입을 사람 또는 중고품 가게에 전달.
❌ ④ a recycling center(재활용 센터): 본문에서 구체적으로 thrift shop 언급.
det.tip: thrift shop = 중고품 가게. 책임 있는 폐기의 구체적 방법.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ① 스타일+지구. ② 새 옷. ③ 브랜드 집착. ④ 생산 증가.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 제시의 옷 습관은 스타일 창조와 지구 보호 모두를 위한 것이다. — not just about creating a style; they are about saving the Earth. 원문 일치. ←정답
❌ ② 제시는 최신 유행의 새 옷을 구매하여 스타일을 완성한다. — She does not buy new clothes. 불일치.
❌ ③ 제시는 특정 브랜드에 대한 강한 애착으로 유명하다. — does not get too attached. 불일치.
❌ ④ 제시의 행동은 옷의 생산과 소비를 증가시키는 데 기여한다. — help reduce. 줄이므로 불일치.
det.tip: not just about A; about B = A뿐만 아니라 B이기도 하다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ① 상당한 자원. ② 농업 폐기물. ③ 카폭+비옥. ④ 폐기물↓.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 의류에 흔히 사용되는 재료는 상당한 자원을 필요로 한다. — require considerable resources. 원문 일치.
❌ ② 기업들은 농업 폐기물에서 추출한 섬유를 개발 중이다. — fibers extracted from agricultural waste products. 원문 일치.
✅ ③ 카폭 나무는 비옥한 토양과 충분한 물이 있어야 잘 자란다. — grow well in poor soil without needing much water. 척박한 토양+적은 물이므로 불일치. ←정답
❌ ④ 새로운 직물들은 폐기물을 적게 생산하고 오래 지속된다. — produce less waste, last a long time. 원문 일치.
det.tip: poor soil(척박한 토양) ≠ 비옥한 토양. without needing much water = 물 적게 필요.

ch: 의류에 흔히 사용되는 재료는 상당한 자원을 필요로 한다.
기업들은 농업 폐기물에서 추출한 섬유를 개발 중이다.
카폭 나무는 비옥한 토양과 충분한 물이 있어야 잘 자란다.
새로운 직물들은 폐기물을 적게 생산하고 오래 지속된다.

❌ ① Circular fashion can immediately solve all environmental problems in the industry. — will not solve every problem overnight. 반대.
❌ ② Consumers should prioritize buying the most affordable clothing options available. — buy only what we need. 가격이 아닌 필요성 기준.
✅ ③ Consumers can drive sustainable change in fashion through conscious purchasing and responsible disposal habits. ←정답: demonstrate concerns through what we buy + discarding responsibly + small changes → gradually improve.
❌ ④ The fashion industry will improve only when companies invest in advanced manufacturing technology. — Another key is the consumer. 소비자 역할 강조.
det.tip: 요지 = 소비자의 의식적 구매 + 책임 있는 폐기 → 점진적 산업 개선.

ch: Circular fashion can immediately solve all environmental problems in the industry.
Consumers should prioritize buying the most affordable clothing options available.
Consumers can drive sustainable change in fashion through conscious purchasing and responsible disposal habits.
The fashion industry will improve only when companies invest in advanced manufacturing technology.

questions.passage: Circular fashion will not solve every problem in the fashion industry overnight.  However, small steps in the right direction are better than nothing.  Keeping things in the supply chain for as many cycles as possible is really important.  By making small changes to our clothing habits today, the fashion industry will gradually improve.  After all, <u>nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet</u>.

overlay.underline: nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 "nothing is more fashionable than saving the planet"이 이 문맥에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 지구를 구하는 것이 가장 '유행에 맞는' 일이다 → 가장 가치 있는 일이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① Wearing eco-friendly clothing is the latest fashion trend. — 친환경 의류가 유행이라는 표면적 의미.
❌ ② People who save the planet are always well-dressed. — 옷과 외모에 대한 문자적 해석.
✅ ③ Protecting the environment is the most worthwhile and admirable thing one can do. ←정답: fashionable을 '유행'이 아닌 '가치 있는/존경할 만한'으로 재정의. 패션 용어를 환경 보호의 가치로 전환한 비유.
❌ ④ The fashion industry will eventually become completely sustainable. — 미래 예측이 아닌 가치 판단의 표현.
det.tip: fashionable = 유행하는 → 문맥에서는 '가장 가치 있는'. 패션 글의 결론에서 '패션'의 의미를 재정의.

ch: Wearing eco-friendly clothing is the latest fashion trend.
People who save the planet are always well-dressed.
Protecting the environment is the most worthwhile and admirable thing one can do.
The fashion industry will eventually become completely sustainable.

questions.passage: Circular fashion is inspired by the principles of a circular economy and sustainable development.  A circular economy is based on limiting waste, keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing <u>them</u>.  In a circular model, we make, use, and reuse materials for as long as possible to extract their maximum value.  Therefore, clothing and textiles are produced, used, and reused to minimize waste.  It is a renewable approach to reduce the fashion industry's environmental impact.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것은?

det.korean: 자원과 재료를 계속 사용하고 재사용하는 것.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 폐기물 — limiting waste의 대상이지만 '재사용'의 대상은 아님.
✅ ② 자원과 재료 ←정답: keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing them → them = resources and materials.
❌ ③ 순환 경제의 원리 — 원리를 재사용한다는 맥락 아님.
❌ ④ 옷과 직물 — 다음 문장에 등장하는 별개 개념.
det.tip: them = resources and materials. 바로 앞 명사구를 받는 대명사.

questions.passage: Materials commonly used in clothing are not eco-friendly because they require considerable resources and often break down slowly.  This creates a need for eco-friendly textile alternatives.  Currently, companies are developing recycled fibers and fibers extracted from agricultural waste products like leaves, peels, and seeds.  One company uses nanotechnology to make soft material from orange peels.  Another makes fabrics from kapok tree seeds.  The trees grow well in poor soil without needing much water.  <u>These</u> new fabrics produce less waste, last a long time, and break down easily.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 These가 가리키는 것은?

det.korean: 오렌지 껍질, 카폭 씨앗 등에서 만든 새 직물들.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 의류에 흔히 사용되는 기존 재료 — not eco-friendly한 기존 재료와 대비되는 '새 직물'이므로 틀림.
❌ ② 농업 폐기물인 잎, 껍질, 씨앗 — 원료이지 직물 자체가 아님.
✅ ④ 나노기술과 카폭 씨앗 등으로 만든 친환경 직물 ←정답: 오렌지 껍질 소재 + 카폭 씨앗 직물 = These new fabrics.
❌ ④ 재활용 섬유만을 지칭 — recycled fibers뿐 아니라 extracted fibers도 포함.
det.tip: These new fabrics = 앞에 소개된 오렌지 껍질 소재 + 카폭 직물 등 친환경 신소재 전체.

ch: 나노기술과 카폭 씨앗 등으로 만든 친환경 직물

questions.passage: Jessi is a fashion blogger who loves unique, vibrant clothes.  But guess what?  She does not buy new clothes.  Instead, she buys them secondhand.  You may think secondhand clothes are old-fashioned, but by buying them, Jessi can try different styles.  She also does not get too attached to any style or brand because there is always another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered.  Jessi's clothing habits are not just about creating a style; they are about saving the Earth.  The reason is that her actions help reduce the production and consumption of clothes.
questions.stem:
다음 글을 읽고 아래 질문에 대한 답을 본문에서 찾아 문장을 완성하시오. (7단어, 영어로)
Q: Why does Jessi not get too attached to any style or brand?
→ Because there is always ________________________.

det.korean: 항상 발견되기를 기다리는 또 다른 흥미로운 옷이 있으므로.
det.analysis: 원문: because there is always another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered. → 빈칸 = another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered. 찾기 유형이므로 passage 노출 정상.
det.tip: another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered = 발견되기를 기다리는 또 다른 흥미로운 옷.

questions.wa: another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered
accept: another exciting outfit waiting to be discovered

questions.passage: Circular fashion is inspired by the principles of a circular economy and sustainable development.  A circular economy is based on limiting waste, keeping resources and materials in use, and reusing them.  In a circular model, we make, use, and reuse materials for as long as possible to extract their maximum value.  Therefore, clothing and textiles are produced, used, and reused to minimize waste.  It is a renewable approach to reduce the fashion industry's environmental impact.  Circular fashion provides numerous benefits.  First, extending the lifespan of fibers significantly reduces textile waste, benefiting the environment.  Second, circular processes utilize chemicals and materials safe for human health and the environment.  This practice protects the environment and consumer health.  Third, materials are regenerated instead of being disposed of, which enables their long-term use.
questions.stem:
다음 글을 읽고 아래 질문에 대한 답을 본문에서 찾아 문장을 완성하시오. (3단어, 영어로)
Q: What does the circular model aim to extract by using materials as long as possible?
→ It aims to extract ________________________.

det.korean: 재료의 최대 가치를 추출하다.
det.analysis: 원문: reuse materials for as long as possible to extract their maximum value. → 빈칸 = their maximum value. 찾기 유형이므로 passage 노출 정상.
det.tip: their maximum value = 재료의 최대 가치.

questions.passage:
Another key to making fashion sustainable is the consumer: us.  If we want the fashion industry to adopt more sustainable practices, we must care about how clothes come to us.  We should then demonstrate our concerns through what we buy.  The market, of course, will respond.  We can also reduce waste by discarding clothes responsibly.  To be specific, we should buy only what we need and pass clothing on to someone who will wear it or to a thrift shop when discarding it.

Circular fashion will not solve every problem in the fashion industry overnight.  However, small steps in the right direction are better than nothing.  Keeping things in the supply chain for as many cycles as possible is really important.
questions.stem: 다음 글에 따르면, 소비자가 구매 행위를 통해 보여주어야 하는 것을 본문에서 찾아 영어로 쓰시오. (2단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 우리의 우려/관심.
det.analysis: demonstrate our concerns through what we buy → 구매를 통해 보여주어야 하는 것 = our concerns. 찾기 유형이므로 passage 노출 정상.
det.tip: our concerns = 우리의 우려/관심사.

questions.passage: In addition to these manufacturing techniques, technology will improve in such a way that it may become normal to produce clothes only when people order them.  This "make-to-order" method will cost more, but then less money will be spent on maintaining offline stores.  And 3D technology will enable people to ______ without trying them on in a store.  In the long run, innovation in production and sales will facilitate sustainable fashion and considerably reduce material waste and logistics emissions.

overlay.blank: see how clothes will fit online

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로)
"옷이 온라인에서 어떻게 맞을지 보다"
[조건] (1) clothes, fit, how, online, see, will을 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 옷이 온라인에서 어떻게 맞을지 보다.
det.analysis: 3D technology will enable people to see how clothes will fit online. → 빈칸 = see how clothes will fit online (6단어). 간접의문문(how + S + V) 구문.
det.tip: see how clothes will fit online = 간접의문문. how + 주어 + 동사 어순.

questions.wa: see how clothes will fit online
accept: see how clothes will fit online

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)
"오늘날 우리의 옷 입는 습관에 작은 변화를 줌으로써"
[조건] (1) By, changes, clothing, habits, making, our, small, to를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 우리의 옷 입는 습관에 작은 변화를 줌으로써.
det.analysis: By making small changes to our clothing habits today → 빈칸 = By making small changes to our clothing habits (8단어). By + 동명사(making) + 전치사구(to our clothing habits) 구문.
det.tip: By + ~ing = ~함으로써. small changes to ~ = ~에 작은 변화.

questions.wa: By making small changes to our clothing habits
accept: By making small changes to our clothing habits
